title: Finite Tate and smooth-purity source base-change comparisons
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative ring in universe $u+1$, let $N>0$ satisfy $NA=0$, and let all schemes have universe $u$. Work in the ordinary unbounded small-etale $A$-module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with derived inverse image and tensor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom, def-weil-derived-tensor]. Use the concrete root-line and normalized transport interface of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows]: $t$ consists of roots and coefficient-line pullback isomorphisms, characterized respectively by inclusion in the units sheaf and the equation on pure tensors. Put $L_T(d)=A_T(d)[2d]$, in the ordered tensor model of $d$ copies of the degree-one root line shifted by two [def-coefficient-twists-detailed, def-amb-vector-integration-charts].

For any $u:X'\to X$ with $N$ invertible on $X$, define $c_{u,d}:Lu^*L_X(d)\simeq L_{X'}(d)$ to be the existing vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback: at $d=0$ it is the coefficient-unit pullback; at $d+1$ it is tensor pullback followed by $c_{u,d}$ and the shifted root-line pullback fixed by $t$. This definition does not require $A$ finite or schemes Noetherian.

More generally, for arbitrary maps $f:X\to Y$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $v:Y'\to Y$, $u:X'\to X$, objects $L\in D(X_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, $L'\in D(X'_{\mathrm{et}},A)$ and $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},A)$, and specified isomorphisms $e:Lu^*Lf^*K\simeq Lf'^*Lv^*K$ and $c:Lu^*L\simeq L'$, define the source comparison
$$Lu^*(Lf^*K\otimes^L L)\simeq Lf'^*Lv^*K\otimes^L L'$$
to be tensor-pullback comparison followed by the tensor of $e$ and $c$; this is the existing ordinaryFiniteTwistedPullbackComparison of [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows].

For a Cartesian square [def-pc-base-change], take $e$ to be the inverse of the canonical derived inverse-image square isomorphism. For $L=L_X(d)$ and $L'=L_{X'}(d)$, take $c=c_{u,d}$. When $A$ is finite, use the actual roots-and-pure-tensor normalized purityTwistTransport of [def-pur-vector-purity-normalization] as $t$. This fixes exactly the twist/pullback and gamma-source identifications in the finite smooth-purity base-change statement; the definitions assert no orientation or exceptional-map compatibility.

def vectorIntegrationBaseCoefficientPullback (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] (N : ℕ)
    (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (d : ℕ) :
    (ordinaryFinitePullback A f).obj (affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA Y d) ≅
      affineLinearBaseCoefficient A N hA X d
